implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Defines the REST API endpoint that receives requests to add new tasks. It validates the input using the TaskCreate model and delegates creation to the service layer.
implementation.name: POST /tasks
implementation.pseudo_code:
When a POST request is made to /tasks with task data:
    Validate the request body against TaskCreate schema
    Call task_service.create_task(task)
    If successful, return the created Task
    If error, raise HTTP 400 with error details

implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Implements the business logic for creating a new task. Receives validated data from the controller and passes it to the repository for persistence.
implementation.name: TaskService.create_task
implementation.pseudo_code:
Log the creation attempt with user_name
Call repository.add_task(task_data)
Return the created Task

implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Handles the actual storage of the new task. Assigns a unique ID, saves the task to persistent storage, and returns the created Task object.
implementation.name: TaskRepository.add_task
implementation.pseudo_code:
Create a new Task object with a unique id and fields from task_data
Append the new Task to the in-memory list
Increment the id counter
Save all tasks to the JSON file
Log the creation
Return the new Task
